name: valuz-dsh-kernel-bridge
description: Valuz-owned Cordis plugin bridging the dsh subprocess to the Valuz kernel: converges dsh plan-mode state to the kernel-desired value at spawn, and registers a ctx.userQuestions provider that forwards exit_plan_mode reviews / ask_user_question calls to the kernel's user-questions HTTP endpoint (standard requires_action approval cards). Installed into the deploy-root closure as a file: dependency; .npmrc install-links=true makes npm copy (not symlink) it into node_modules so the staged desktop closure stays self-contained. After editing this package, re-run `bash scripts/vendor-dsh-runtime.sh --update` to refresh the copy.
